caption: The pipeline mechanics are solved. The cadence strategy isn't.

eyebrow: Three teams, one instance, one upgrade
code:
Team A: ships weekly  (low-risk app)
Team B: ships quarterly (large, high-dependency app)
Team C: ships on partner API changes

...all six weeks from the same platform upgrade
caption: Each cadence is fine alone. Together, they collide.

eyebrow: Why the collision is a planning failure
code:
If Team A ships weekly through the upgrade
testing window:
  pre-upgrade sandbox = moving target
  -> upgrade validation never has a stable baseline
caption: Neither team did anything wrong by its own cadence.

steps.label: Change freeze window
steps.sub: critical fixes only, for a defined period before go-live

steps.label: Negotiate, not mandate

steps.label: Every team has a voice
